basic_info.description: Charming duplex with excellent investment potential, and perfect for multi family living, or live in one unit and collect rent income on the other.  Both units are vacant and beautifully staged. The top unit is a 3 bedroom 1.5 bath freshly painted with updated flooring. The bottom unit is a 2 bedroom 1 bath. The garage can comfortably fit three cars.  Both units feature separate entrances. The spacious yard is perfect for garden enthusiasts & hosting gatherings. We are located near Cow Palace, shopping, parks, and close to highway 101 and convenient transportation!
